title: Jose M NDE 21460
content: I served with 101st airborne division in Vietnam from April, 1969 to May, 1970. May 21, we came against a well-fortified enemy. We attacked a hill next to a wall by a rice paddy. Just before night, we were told to get our combat gear to charge the hill. I was pretty scared because I knew that maybe I’d get killed. As we attacked the hill, a mortar landed behind me and I flew thru the sky. The first thing I did was pray for forgiveness, then all of sudden I could see myself laying the ground. I had no more fear but only peace. I wish I never came back but as I laid there all night, they came to pick me up. Once someone touched me I came back to my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes I was wounded In Vietnam. I could see myself on the ground. While I was there on the battlefield, combat continued.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was separated from my body. I could see down to it.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Peace was the greater emotion.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I don't fear death anymore.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best part: I had no fear.
